description: Bumps the exact version pins in this repo once a release is 7 days old (most compromised releases are caught and pulled within days).
Patch/minor/digest bumps merge themselves; majors open a PR for review. Fixes for known vulnerabilities skip the wait.
Pins are found via '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comments on the line above each one.

packageRules.description: Low-risk updates merge on their own once the wait is over.
Majors (e.g. Node 26 -> 27) wait for a human.

customManagers.description: Exact pins in the proto toolchain and .chezmoidata.toml, each preceded by a '# renovate:' comment.
